records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.LoadingScreen.blow_away#1
records.source: The logo holds until two seconds after the cover first painted (at once when called later than that), then blows away over four seconds: the black container fades from one to three seconds in and the last tile has gone at four. The cover deletes itself then.
records.context: The logo holds until two seconds after the cover first painted (at once when called later than that), then blows away over four seconds: the black container fades from one to three seconds in and the last tile has gone at four. The cover deletes itself then.
records.translation: 로고는 커버가 처음 그려진 뒤 2초까지 유지되고(나중에 호출되면 즉시), 이후 4초에 걸쳐 날려 보내집니다. 검은 컨테이너는 1초에서 3초 사이에 사라지고 마지막 타일은 4초에 사라집니다. 그러면 커버는 스스로 삭제됩니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.LoadingScreen.container_opacity#1
records.source: 1.0 until a second into the blow-away, then falling monotonically to 0.0 three seconds in (over the one second of the plain cross-fade under Reduce motion); 0.0 once the cover is done.
records.context: 1.0 until a second into the blow-away, then falling monotonically to 0.0 three seconds in (over the one second of the plain cross-fade under Reduce motion); 0.0 once the cover is done.
records.translation: 날려 보내기 시작 후 1초까지 1.0, 이후 3초에 0.0이 될 때까지 단조롭게 감소합니다(모션 줄이기에서는 단순 크로스페이드 1초 동안). 커버가 끝나면 0.0.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.blow_away_running#1
records.source: Idle-time warming asks this and waits, so its slices do not take frames from the animation in the four seconds it runs. While the logo only holds, the window keeps loading underneath it.
records.context: Idle-time warming asks this and waits, so its slices do not take frames from the animation in the four seconds it runs. While the logo only holds, the window keeps loading underneath it.
records.translation: 유휴 시간 워밍업이 이를 묻고 기다리므로, 그 조각이 애니메이션이 진행되는 4초 동안 프레임을 빼앗지 않습니다. 로고가 유지되기만 하는 동안에는 그 아래에서 창이 계속 로드됩니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.blow_away_running#2
records.source: ``True`` while any cover that still exists is past its hold and drawing; a cover deleted mid-way, with its window, no longer counts.

records.translation: 아직 존재하는 커버가 유지 시간을 지나 그리고 있는 동안 ``True``. 창과 함께 도중에 삭제된 커버는 더 이상 세지 않습니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.replay_startup_animation#1
records.source: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for two seconds and blows away as it does at startup. It plays even when Preferences > Animation > Startup animation is off; under Accessibility > Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away in one second. A click or a key skips it. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
records.context: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for two seconds and blows away as it does at startup. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
records.translation: Help > Show startup animation. 로고가 있는 검은 컨테이너가 창 위로 돌아와 2초 동안 유지된 뒤 시작할 때처럼 날려 보내집니다. Preferences > 애니메이션 > 시작 애니메이션이 꺼져 있어도 재생되며, 접근성 > 모션 줄이기에서는 로고가 유지된 뒤 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃됩니다. 클릭하거나 키를 누르면 건너뜁니다. 창의 크기, 상태, 키보드 포커스는 그대로 둡니다.
